test-delegate-bypasses-stub.title: The new assertion fails because the reader bypasses participant binding
test-delegate-bypasses-stub.description: `service.getSession()` reaches `readSession()`, which returns `right(row)` without calling `bindSession` or `scopes.participantSession`. The result is therefore not the arranged database failure, so `assertDatabaseFailure` throws and this test fails. The participant projection failure is unreachable through this call path.
test-delegate-bypasses-stub.evidence: `access.session` uses `flatMap(scopes.session(), readSession)`, and `readSession` returns `right(row)`. `bindSession` is defined but never called; consequently `service.getSession()` returns a right result and `assertDatabaseFailure` rejects it.
test-delegate-bypasses-stub.suggestion: If the test is meant to verify participant projection failures, make the reader bind the session participants before returning the session. Otherwise, change the assertion to match the successful result this call path produces.

test-empty-participants-skip-stub.title: Assertion expects an error from an empty participant list
test-empty-participants-skip-stub.description: `row.participants` is empty, so `bindSession` never calls `scopes.participantSession` and returns the session successfully. Consequently `service.getSession()` produces a right result and `assertDatabaseFailure` throws; the new test fails instead of exercising the claimed projection error.
test-empty-participants-skip-stub.evidence: The loop iterates `session.participants`, which is `[]`; the only call producing `left(failure)` is inside that loop. The assertion then requires the result to be that left value.
test-empty-participants-skip-stub.suggestion: Make the fixture include a participant if the intent is to test propagation of a participant projection failure, or assert success for the empty-participants case.

test-recovery-swallows-bound-failure.title: Projection database failure is converted into success
test-recovery-swallows-bound-failure.description: When participant binding returns the arranged database failure, `readSession` replaces the left result with `right(row)`. The service therefore returns a successful session instead of propagating the failure, so the new assertion fails despite the participant lookup being called.
test-recovery-swallows-bound-failure.evidence: `bindSession` returns `left(failure)` for the participant lookup, but this branch returns `right(row)`. The assertion requires the original failure object to remain the result.
test-recovery-swallows-bound-failure.suggestion: Propagate the left result from `flatMap` instead of converting it to a successful row.

test-delegate-bypasses-stub.title: Test expects a projection error the public path never reaches
test-delegate-bypasses-stub.description: The new test calls `service.getSession()`, which delegates to `access.session()`. That path reads the session with `readSession`, which returns `right(row)` directly; it never calls `bindSession` or `scopes.participantSession`. Consequently the result is a right value, and `assertDatabaseFailure` throws instead of observing the arranged projection error.
test-delegate-bypasses-stub.evidence: `readSession` returns `right(row)` without binding participants, and `access.session` passes that reader to `flatMap`. `service.getSession()` therefore returns `right(row)` and leaves `calls` at zero; the assertion on this line requires a left result containing `failure`.
test-delegate-bypasses-stub.suggestion: If the test is meant to verify participant projection failure, make the public read path bind participants before asserting that failure.

test-empty-participants-skip-stub.title: Test expects an error from an empty participant list
test-empty-participants-skip-stub.description: The fixture sets `participants` to an empty array, so `bindSession` never calls `scopes.participantSession` and returns the session successfully. Consequently, `service.getSession()` is a `right` result and `assertDatabaseFailure` throws; this test fails instead of verifying the expected projection error.
test-empty-participants-skip-stub.evidence: `bindSession` only invokes `scopes.participantSession` inside `for (const participant of session.participants)`, while the fixture defines `participants: []`. The new test calls `assertDatabaseFailure(service.getSession())`, which requires a `left` result.
test-empty-participants-skip-stub.suggestion: Use a fixture with a participant so the binder invokes `participantSession`, or change the assertion to match the successful result for an empty list.

test-recovery-swallows-bound-failure.title: Test fails because the projection failure is swallowed
test-recovery-swallows-bound-failure.description: The participant binding returns the arranged database failure, but `readSession` converts that failure into `right(row)`. Consequently, `service.getSession()` returns a successful result and this assertion throws instead of passing.
test-recovery-swallows-bound-failure.evidence: `bindSession` returns the `left(failure)` from `participantSession`; `readSession` then returns `right(row)` for any left result. `assertDatabaseFailure` therefore receives a right result at the new test call.
test-recovery-swallows-bound-failure.suggestion: Preserve the left result from `bindSession` through `readSession` so the database failure reaches the assertion.
